-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency text DEFAULT 'GHS',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx
  ON public.paystack_transactions(reference);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ALTER COLUMN file_storage_path DROP NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('task-deliverables', 'task-deliverables', false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner insert" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner insert"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner read" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner read"
ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner delete" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency text DEFAULT 'GHS',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx
  ON public.paystack_transactions(reference);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ALTER COLUMN file_storage_path DROP NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('task-deliverables', 'task-deliverables', false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner insert" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner insert"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner read" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner read"
ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner delete" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

===== PAYSTACK HARDENING MIGRATION =====
-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency text DEFAULT 'GHS',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx
  ON public.paystack_transactions(reference);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ALTER COLUMN file_storage_path DROP NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('task-deliverables', 'task-deliverables', false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner insert" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner insert"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner read" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner read"
ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner delete" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency text DEFAULT 'GHS',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx
  ON public.paystack_transactions(reference);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ALTER COLUMN file_storage_path DROP NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('task-deliverables', 'task-deliverables', false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner insert" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner insert"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner read" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner read"

USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner delete" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

===== PAYSTACK MIGRATION =====
-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency text DEFAULT 'GHS',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx
  ON public.paystack_transactions(reference);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ALTER COLUMN file_storage_path DROP NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('task-deliverables', 'task-deliverables', false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner insert" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner insert"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner read" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner read"
ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner delete" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

===== TASK SUBMISSION FLOW =====
      setTaskError('');

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('task_catalog')
        .select('id, title, description, level, pay, visibility')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Task catalog error:', error);
        setTaskError('We could not load the available tasks.');
        setTasks([]);
      } else {
        setTasks((data ?? []) as Task[]);
      }

      setIsLoadingTasks(false);
    }

    loadTasks();
  }, []);

  const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => {
    if (audienceFilter === 'all') {
      return tasks;
    }

    return tasks.filter(
      (task) =>
        task.visibility === audienceFilter || task.visibility === 'all',
    );
  }, [audienceFilter, tasks]);

  const handleStartTask = (task: Task) => {
    setActiveTask(task);
    setSubmissionText('');
    setSuccessMessage('');
    setSubmissionError('');
  };

  const handleFormSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!activeTask) {
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmissionError('');
    setSuccessMessage('');

    try {
      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (userError) {
        throw new Error(userError.message);
      }

      if (!user) {
        throw new Error('You must be signed in before submitting a task.');
      }

      const cleanedText = submissionText.trim();

      if (!cleanedText) {
        throw new Error('Please enter your task work before submitting.');
      }

      const { error: submissionInsertError } = await supabase
        .from('task_submissions')
        .insert({
          task_id: activeTask.id,
          user_id: user.id,
          applicant_id: user.id,
          submission_text: cleanedText,
          status: 'submitted',
          submitted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        });

      if (submissionInsertError) {
        throw new Error(submissionInsertError.message);
      }

      setSuccessMessage(
        `Your submission for "${activeTask.title}" was sent successfully.`,
      );
      setSubmissionText('');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Task submission error:', error);

      setSubmissionError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'Something went wrong while submitting your task.',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="sb-stack">
      {/* Learner bands */}
      <div className="sb-card-grid sb-card-grid-compact">
        {learnerBands.map((band) => (
          <article key={band.title} className="sb-card">
            <span className="sb-status-pill">{band.range}</span>

            <h3>{band.title}</h3>

            <p>{band.summary}</p>

            <ul className="sb-simple-list">
              {band.points.map((point) => (
                <li key={point}>{point}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </article>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Task catalog */}
      <div className="sb-panel">
        <div className="sb-section-heading">
          <div>
            <span className="sb-eyebrow">Paid task marketplace</span>

            <h2>Learn, practice, complete tasks, and earn</h2>

===== PAYSTACK MIGRATION =====
-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency text DEFAULT 'GHS',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx
  ON public.paystack_transactions(reference);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ALTER COLUMN file_storage_path DROP NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('task-deliverables', 'task-deliverables', false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner insert" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner insert"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner read" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner read"
ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner delete" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

===== TASK SUBMISSION FLOW =====
      setTaskError('');

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('task_catalog')
        .select('id, title, description, level, pay, visibility')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Task catalog error:', error);
        setTaskError('We could not load the available tasks.');
        setTasks([]);
      } else {
        setTasks((data ?? []) as Task[]);
      }

      setIsLoadingTasks(false);
    }

    loadTasks();
  }, []);

  const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => {
    if (audienceFilter === 'all') {
      return tasks;
    }

    return tasks.filter(
      (task) =>
        task.visibility === audienceFilter || task.visibility === 'all',
    );
  }, [audienceFilter, tasks]);

  const handleStartTask = (task: Task) => {
    setActiveTask(task);
    setSubmissionText('');
    setSuccessMessage('');
    setSubmissionError('');
  };

  const handleFormSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!activeTask) {
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmissionError('');
    setSuccessMessage('');

    try {
      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (userError) {
        throw new Error(userError.message);
      }

      if (!user) {
        throw new Error('You must be signed in before submitting a task.');
      }

      const cleanedText = submissionText.trim();

      if (!cleanedText) {
        throw new Error('Please enter your task work before submitting.');
      }

      const { error: submissionInsertError } = await supabase
        .from('task_submissions')
        .insert({
          task_id: activeTask.id,
          user_id: user.id,
          applicant_id: user.id,
          submission_text: cleanedText,
          status: 'submitted',
          submitted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        });

      if (submissionInsertError) {
        throw new Error(submissionInsertError.message);
      }

      setSuccessMessage(
        `Your submission for "${activeTask.title}" was sent successfully.`,
      );
      setSubmissionText('');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Task submission error:', error);

      setSubmissionError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'Something went wrong while submitting your task.',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="sb-stack">
      {/* Learner bands */}
      <div className="sb-card-grid sb-card-grid-compact">
        {learnerBands.map((band) => (
          <article key={band.title} className="sb-card">
            <span className="sb-status-pill">{band.range}</span>

            <h3>{band.title}</h3>

            <p>{band.summary}</p>

            <ul className="sb-simple-list">
              {band.points.map((point) => (
                <li key={point}>{point}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </article>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Task catalog */}
      <div className="sb-panel">
        <div className="sb-section-heading">
          <div>
            <span className="sb-eyebrow">Paid task marketplace</span>

  98: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  99:   p_reference text,
 100:   p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
 101:   p_amount numeric,
 102:   p_currency text,
 103:   p_user_id uuid
 104: )
 105: RETURNS jsonb
 106: LANGUAGE plpgsql
 107: SECURITY DEFINER
 108: SET search_path = public, pg_temp
 109: AS $$
 110: DECLARE
 111:   payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
 112: BEGIN
 113:   IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
 114:      OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
 115:      OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
 116:      OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
 117:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
 118:   END IF;
 119:
 120:   SELECT * INTO payment_row
 121:   FROM public.paystack_transactions
 122:   WHERE reference = p_reference
 123:   FOR UPDATE;
 124:
 125:   IF NOT FOUND THEN
 126:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
 127:   END IF;
 128:
 129:   IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
 130:      OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
 131:      OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
 132:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
 133:   END IF;
 134:
 135:   IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
 136:     IF EXISTS (
 137:       SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
 138:       WHERE reference = p_reference
 139:         AND user_id = p_user_id
 140:         AND amount = p_amount
 141:         AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
 142:     ) THEN
 143:       RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
 144:     END IF;
 145:
 146:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
 147:   END IF;
 148:
 149:   IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
 150:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
 151:   END IF;
 152:
 153:   IF EXISTS (
 154:     SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
 155:     WHERE reference = p_reference
 156:   ) THEN
 157:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
 158:   END IF;
 159:
 160:   INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
 161:     (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
 162:   VALUES
 163:     (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);
 164:
 165:   INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
 166:     (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
 167:   VALUES
 168:     (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
 169:   ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
 170:   SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
 171:       total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,

]633;D;0]633;A]633;P;Cwd=C:\x5cUsers\x5cICESSES\x5cDownloads\x5cSKILLBRIDGE-live-fixPS C:\Users\ICESSES\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix> ]633;B
PS>Get-Content ".\apps\web\app\api\wallet\balance\route.ts" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
    const anonKey =
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ||
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;

    if (!supabaseUrl || !anonKey) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Wallet service is not configured." },
        { status: 503 },
      );
    }

    const authorization = request.headers.get("authorization");
    const token = authorization?.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i)?.[1];

    if (!token) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please sign in to view your wallet." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
      auth: {
        persistSession: false,
        autoRefreshToken: false,
      },
      global: {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
      },
    });

    const { data: authData, error: authError } =
      await supabase.auth.getUser(token);

    if (authError || !authData.user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Your session is invalid or expired." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    const { data: wallet, error: walletError } = await supabase
      .from("platform_wallets")
      .select("available_balance, total_earnings")
      .eq("user_id", authData.user.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (walletError) {
      console.error("Wallet balance lookup failed:", walletError.message);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Wallet balance is temporarily unavailable." },
        { status: 503 },
      );
    }

    const balance = wallet ? Number(wallet.available_balance) : 0;

    if (!Number.isFinite(balance) || balance < 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Wallet balance is invalid." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      balance,
      currency: "GHS",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Wallet balance API failed:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Wallet balance is temporarily unavailable." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency text DEFAULT 'GHS',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx
  ON public.paystack_transactions(reference);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ALTER COLUMN file_storage_path DROP NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('task-deliverables', 'task-deliverables', false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner insert" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner insert"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner read" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner read"
ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner delete" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

create or replace function public.increment_wallet_balance(target_user_id uuid, amount_to_add numeric)
returns void as $$
begin
    insert into public.platform_wallets (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings)
    values (target_user_id, amount_to_add, amount_to_add)
    on conflict (user_id) do update
    set available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + amount_to_add,
        total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + amount_to_add,
        updated_at = now();
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

CREATE TYPE user_role_tier AS ENUM ('customer', 'vendor_micro', 'vendor_elite', 'driver_rider', 'admin_central');
CREATE TYPE verification_status AS ENUM ('pending', 'verified', 'suspended');
CREATE TYPE delivery_status AS ENUM ('idle', 'active_routine', 'part_time');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (
    id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE PRIMARY KEY,
    legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone_number TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    role_tier user_role_tier DEFAULT 'customer'::user_role_tier,
    verification verification_status DEFAULT 'pending'::verification_status,
    national_id_hash TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT TIMEZONE('utc'::text, NOW()) NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT TIMEZONE('utc'::text, NOW()) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.platform_wallets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    profile_id UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    balance_cents BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT check_positive_balance CHECK (balance_cents >= 0),
    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'GHS' NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT TIMEZONE('utc'::text, NOW()) NOT NULL
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_profile_wallet_provision()
RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets (profile_id, balance_cents, currency)
    VALUES (NEW.id, 0, 'GHS') ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO NOTHING;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

===== 2. PAYSTACK MIGRATION =====
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

  $link = Join-Path $web ".vercel\project.json"
  if (!(Test-Path $link)) {
    throw "No Vercel project link found under apps/web. Deployment cancelled to avoid deploying the wrong project."

  $project = Get-Content $link -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (!$project.projectId -or !$project.orgId) {
    throw "Vercel project link is incomplete. Deployment cancelled."
  }

  Log "Existing Vercel project link found. IDs are not printed."

  $who = & vercel whoami 2>&1

PS>try {
    Write-Log "`n===== SKILLBRIDGE EXISTING PROJECT DEPLOYMENT ====="
    Write-Log "Time: $(Get-Date -Format o)"
    Write-Log "Repository: $root"

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $web "package.json"))) {
        throw "apps/web/package.json was not found. Stopping without changing files."
    }

    Write-Log "`n===== CHECK VERCEL LOGIN ====="
    & vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Vercel login is required. Run: vercel login"
    }

    Write-Log "`n===== EXISTING VERCEL PROJECTS ====="
    & vercel projects ls
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not list Vercel projects. No deployment attempted."
    }

    Write-Host "`nSelect the EXISTING SkillBridge production project when prompted." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "Do not create a new project. If unsure which project is correct, cancel." -ForegroundColor Yellow

    Push-Location $web
    try {
        Write-Log "`n===== LINK EXISTING VERCEL PROJECT ====="
        & vercel link
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Vercel linking did not complete. Deployment cancelled."
        }

        $linkFile = Join-Path $web ".vercel\project.json"
        if (-not (Test-Path $linkFile)) {
            throw "Vercel did not create apps/web/.vercel/project.json."
        }

        $link = Get-Content $linkFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($link.projectId) -or
            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($link.orgId)) {
            throw "The Vercel project link is incomplete. Deployment cancelled."
        }

        Write-Log "Vercel project link verified."
        Write-Log "Project ID: $($link.projectId)"
        Write-Log "`n===== TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION ====="

        & npx tsc --noEmit
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "TypeScript validation failed. Fix errors before deployment."
        }

        Write-Log "`n===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
        & npm run build
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Production build failed. Deployment cancelled."
        }

        Write-Log "`n===== DEPLOY TO PRODUCTION ====="
        & vercel deploy --prod --yes
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Vercel production deployment failed. Review the output above."
        }

        Write-Log "`nVERCEL PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT COMMAND SUCCEEDED."
    }
    finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Log "`nSTOPPED SAFELY: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    throw
}

PS>try {
    Log "`n===== VERIFY EXISTING VERCEL LINK ====="

    $linkDir = Join-Path $web ".vercel"
    if (-not (Test-Path $linkDir)) {
        throw "Vercel link directory is missing. No deployment attempted."
    }

    $linkFiles = Get-ChildItem $linkDir -Force -File
    $linkFiles | Select-Object Name, Length | Format-Table | Out-String | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append

    $projectFile = Join-Path $linkDir "project.json"
    $projectLinked = $false

    if (Test-Path $projectFile) {
        $project = Get-Content $projectFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        if ($project.projectId -and $project.orgId) {
            $projectLinked = $true
        }
    }

    if (-not $projectLinked) {
        $configFile = Join-Path $linkDir "link.json"
        if (Test-Path $configFile) {
            $config = Get-Content $configFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
            if ($config.projectId -and $config.orgId) {
                $projectLinked = $true
            }
        }
    }

    if (-not $projectLinked) {
        Log "Standard project metadata not found. Asking Vercel CLI to confirm the linked project."
        & vercel project inspect skillbridge-web
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Could not confirm the existing skillbridge-web project. Stop and inspect the link files above."
        }
    }

    Log "`n===== TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION ====="
    & npx tsc --noEmit
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "TypeScript validation failed. Fix reported errors before deploying."
    }

    Log "`n===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
    & npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Production build failed. Deployment cancelled."
    }

    Log "`n===== DEPLOY EXISTING LINKED PROJECT ====="
    & vercel deploy --prod --yes
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Production deployment failed. Review the Vercel output."
    }

    Log "`nVERCEL DEPLOYMENT COMMAND SUCCEEDED."
}
catch {
    Log "`nSTOPPED SAFELY: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    throw
}
