PS>try {
    Set-Location $root

    Log "`n===== SKILLBRIDGE SAFE DEPLOYMENT ====="
    Log "Repository: $root"
    Log "Web app: $web"
    Log "No Git reset, clean, or source overwrite will be run."

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $web "package.json"))) {
        throw "apps/web/package.json is missing. No deployment attempted."
    }

    if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "Node.js is unavailable in this PowerShell session."
    }

    if (-not (Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "npm is unavailable in this PowerShell session."
    }

    if (-not (Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "Vercel CLI is unavailable. Install or enable it before continuing."
    }

    Log "`n===== VERCEL ACCOUNT ====="
    & vercel whoami 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Vercel authentication failed. Sign in before continuing."
    }

    Log "`n===== SEARCH EXISTING VERCEL LINKS ====="

    $linkCandidates = @(
        (Join-Path $web ".vercel\project.json"),
        (Join-Path $root ".vercel\project.json")
    )

    $linkFile = $linkCandidates |
        Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $linkFile) {
        Log "No existing link found at the app or repository root."
        Log "Checking Vercel projects before linking."

        Set-Location $web
        & vercel project ls 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Could not list Vercel projects. No deployment attempted."
        }

        Log "`nA project must be linked before deployment."
        Log "Run 'vercel link' below and select the EXISTING SkillBridge production project."
        Log "Do not create a new project or change project settings."

        & vercel link
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Vercel linking did not complete. No deployment attempted."
        }

        $linkFile = Join-Path $web ".vercel\project.json"

        if (-not (Test-Path $linkFile)) {
            throw "The expected apps/web Vercel link was not created."
        }
    }

    Log "`n===== VERIFY LINKED PROJECT ====="

    $link = Get-Content $linkFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$link.projectId) -or
        [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$link.orgId)) {
        throw "Vercel link metadata is incomplete. No deployment attempted."
    }

    Log "Link file: $linkFile"
    Log "Project ID: $($link.projectId)"
    Log "Organization ID: $($link.orgId)"

    Set-Location $web

    Log "`n===== VERIFY DEPENDENCIES ====="

    if (-not (Test-Path "node_modules")) {
        Log "Installing dependencies using the existing lockfile where available."

        if (Test-Path "package-lock.json") {
            & npm ci
        } elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $root "package-lock.json")) {
            & npm ci --prefix $root
        } else {
            throw "No package-lock.json found for a safe reproducible install. No files were intentionally overwritten."
        }

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Dependency installation failed."
        }
    }

    Log "`n===== AVAILABLE VALIDATION SCRIPTS ====="

    $pkg = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $scripts = $pkg.scripts

    if ($scripts.typecheck) {
        & npm run typecheck
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "TypeScript validation failed. Deployment cancelled."
        }
    } elseif ($scripts."type-check") {
        & npm run type-check
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "TypeScript validation failed. Deployment cancelled."
        }
    } elseif ($scripts.lint) {
        Log "No typecheck script found; running the existing lint script."
        & npm run lint
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Lint validation failed. Deployment cancelled."
        }
    } else {
        Log "No dedicated typecheck or lint script found; the production build will be the main validation."
    }

    Log "`n===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="

    & npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Production build failed. Deployment cancelled."
    }

    Log "`n===== DEPLOY EXISTING LINKED PROJECT ====="

    & vercel deploy --prod --yes
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Production deployment failed. Review the Vercel output."
    }

    Log "`nVERCEL DEPLOYMENT COMMAND SUCCEEDED."
}
catch {
    Log "`nSTOPPED SAFELY: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    throw
}

PS>function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [string]$Command,
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [string]$Failure
    )

    # Keep native CLI stderr from being mistaken for a PowerShell
    # terminating error. Check the actual process exit code instead.
    $oldNativePreference = $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference
    try {
        $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
    } catch {}

    try {
        & $Command @Arguments 2>&1 |
            ForEach-Object {
                "$_" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
            }

        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    } finally {
        try {
            $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $oldNativePreference
        } catch {}
    }

    if ($code -ne 0) {
        throw "$Failure Exit code: $code"
    }
}

PS>try {
    Set-Location $root

    Log "`n===== SKILLBRIDGE DEPLOYMENT CONTINUATION ====="
    Log "Repository: $root"
    Log "No Git reset, clean, or source-code overwrite will be run."

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $web "package.json"))) {
        throw "apps/web/package.json is missing."
    }

    $vercelCommand = Get-Command vercel.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $vercelCommand) {
        $vercelCommand = Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    if (-not $vercelCommand) {
        throw "Vercel CLI is not available."
    }

    $vercelExe = $vercelCommand.Source
    if (-not $vercelExe) {
        $vercelExe = $vercelCommand.Name
    }

    Log "`n===== VERIFY VERCEL ACCOUNT ====="
    Invoke-Native $vercelExe @("whoami") "Vercel login check failed."

    Log "`n===== FIND EXISTING VERCEL LINK ====="

    $linkFile = $null
    $searchDirs = @($web, $root) | Select-Object -Unique

    foreach ($dir in $searchDirs) {
        $candidate = Join-Path $dir ".vercel\project.json"
        if (Test-Path $candidate) {
            $linkFile = $candidate
            break
        }
    }

    if (-not $linkFile) {
        Log "No existing link found in apps/web or repository root."
        Log "Searching this repository for other Vercel project links."

        $found = Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Filter project.json `
            -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object {
                $_.FullName -match '[\\/]\.vercel[\\/]project\.json$' -and
                $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/](node_modules|\.next)[\\/]'
            } |
            Select-Object -First 1

        if ($found) {
            $linkFile = $found.FullName
            Log "Found existing metadata: $linkFile"
        }
    }

    if (-not $linkFile) {
        Log "`n===== LINK EXISTING VERCEL PROJECT ====="
        Log "Select the existing SkillBridge project when prompted."
        Log "Do not create a replacement project."

        Set-Location $web
        Invoke-Native $vercelExe @("link") `
            "Vercel linking failed or was cancelled."

        $linkFile = Join-Path $web ".vercel\project.json"

        if (-not (Test-Path $linkFile)) {
            throw "The expected Vercel link file was not created."
        }
    }

    Log "`n===== VALIDATE VERCEL LINK ====="

    $link = Get-Content $linkFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$link.projectId) -or
        [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$link.orgId)) {
        throw "Vercel link metadata is incomplete."
    }

    Log "Link file: $linkFile"
    Log "Project ID: $($link.projectId)"
    Log "Organization ID: $($link.orgId)"

    Set-Location $web

    Log "`n===== VERIFY PACKAGE MANAGER FILES ====="

    $pkg = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $lockCandidates = @(
        (Join-Path $web "package-lock.json"),
        (Join-Path $web "npm-shrinkwrap.json"),
        (Join-Path $root "package-lock.json"),
        (Join-Path $root "pnpm-lock.yaml"),
        (Join-Path $root "yarn.lock")
    )

    $existingLocks = $lockCandidates | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }
    if (-not $existingLocks) {
        throw "No existing dependency lockfile found. Stopping rather than guessing a package installation."
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path "node_modules") -and
        -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $root "node_modules"))) {
        Log "Dependencies are not installed locally."
        Log "Using the existing npm lockfile to install dependencies."

        if (Test-Path "package-lock.json") {
            Invoke-Native "npm.cmd" @("ci") "npm ci failed."
        } elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $root "package-lock.json")) {
            Set-Location $root
            Invoke-Native "npm.cmd" @("ci") "Root npm ci failed."
            Set-Location $web
        } else {
            throw "The available lockfile is not an npm lockfile. Install using the repository's existing package manager."
        }
    }

    Log "`n===== RUN AVAILABLE VALIDATION ====="

    $scripts = $pkg.scripts
    $validated = $false

    if ($scripts -and $scripts.typecheck) {
        Invoke-Native "npm.cmd" @("run", "typecheck") `
            "TypeScript validation failed."
        $validated = $true
    } elseif ($scripts -and $scripts."type-check") {
        Invoke-Native "npm.cmd" @("run", "type-check") `
            "TypeScript validation failed."
        $validated = $true
    } elseif ($scripts -and $scripts.lint) {
        Invoke-Native "npm.cmd" @("run", "lint") `
            "Lint validation failed."
        $validated = $true
    }

    if (-not $validated) {
        Log "No dedicated typecheck/lint script exists. The production build will validate the application."
    }

    Log "`n===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
    Invoke-Native "npm.cmd" @("run", "build") `
        "Production build failed. Deployment cancelled."

    Log "`n===== DEPLOY LINKED PRODUCTION PROJECT ====="
    Set-Location $web

    Invoke-Native $vercelExe @("deploy", "--prod", "--yes") `
        "Vercel production deployment failed."

    Log "`nDEPLOYMENT COMMAND COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY."
}
catch {
    Log "`nSTOPPED SAFELY: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    throw
}

    if (-not (Test-Path $cli)) {
        $globalRoot = (& npm.cmd root -g 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 1)
        $cli = Join-Path "$globalRoot" "vercel\dist\vc.js"
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path $cli)) {
        throw "Could not locate the installed Vercel CLI JavaScript entry point."
    }

    Log "Using existing Vercel CLI: $cli"

    # Run Node directly and do not pipe CLI stderr through PowerShell.
    & $node $cli whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Vercel account check failed. Sign in with 'vercel login' and rerun this script."
    }

    $linkFile = $null
    foreach ($dir in @($web, $root)) {
        $candidate = Join-Path $dir ".vercel\project.json"
        if (Test-Path $candidate) {
            $linkFile = $candidate
            break
        }
    }

    if (-not $linkFile) {
        Log "No existing link found. Link the existing SkillBridge production project."
        Set-Location $web
        & $node $cli link
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Vercel linking failed or was cancelled."
        }
        $linkFile = Join-Path $web ".vercel\project.json"
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path $linkFile)) {
        throw "Vercel project link is still missing. No deployment attempted."
    }

    $link = Get-Content $linkFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$link.projectId) -or
        [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$link.orgId)) {
        throw "Vercel project metadata is incomplete."
    }

    Log "Verified existing Vercel project ID: $($link.projectId)"
    Set-Location $web

    $pkg = Get-Content "package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $scripts = $pkg.scripts

    if (-not (Test-Path "node_modules") -and
        -not (Test-Path "$root\node_modules")) {
        if (Test-Path "package-lock.json") {
            Run-Checked "INSTALL EXISTING LOCKFILE DEPENDENCIES" {
                npm.cmd ci
            }
        } elseif (Test-Path "$root\package-lock.json") {
            Set-Location $root
            Run-Checked "INSTALL ROOT LOCKFILE DEPENDENCIES" {
                npm.cmd ci
            }
            Set-Location $web
        } else {
            throw "Dependencies are missing and no npm lockfile is available. No guessed installation will be run."
        }
    }

    if ($scripts.typecheck) {
        Run-Checked "TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION" { npm.cmd run typecheck }
    } elseif ($scripts."type-check") {
        Run-Checked "TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION" { npm.cmd run type-check }
    } elseif ($scripts.lint) {
        Run-Checked "EXISTING LINT SCRIPT" { npm.cmd run lint }
    } else {
        Log "No dedicated typecheck or lint script exists."
    }

    Run-Checked "PRODUCTION BUILD" { npm.cmd run build }

    Run-Checked "VERCEL PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT" {
        & $node $cli deploy --prod --yes
    }

    Log "`nDEPLOYMENT COMMAND SUCCEEDED."
}
catch {
    Log "`nSTOPPED SAFELY: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    throw
}

PS>foreach ($file in @(
    "$root\package.json",
    "$web\package.json",
    "$root\vercel.json",
    "$web\vercel.json"
)) {
    "`n===== $file =====" | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append

    if (Test-Path $file) {
        if ($file -like "*package.json") {
            try {
                $pkg = Get-Content $file -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
                [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Name         = $pkg.name
                    PackageManager = $pkg.packageManager
                    Engines      = ($pkg.engines | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
                    Workspaces   = ($pkg.workspaces | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
                    Scripts      = ($pkg.scripts | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5)
                } | Format-List | Out-String |
                    Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
            } catch {
                "Could not parse package.json: $_" |
                    Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
            }
        } else {
            Get-Content $file |
                Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
        }
    } else {
        "File not present." | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
    }
}

PS>function Invoke-Vercel([string[]]$Arguments) {
    $output = @(& $node $cli @Arguments 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" })

        ExitCode = $code
    }

PS>function Run-Native {
    param(
        [string]$Label,
        [string]$Exe,
        [string[]]$Args
    )
    Log "`n===== $Label ====="
    try {
        $output = @(& $Exe @Args 2>&1)
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        foreach ($item in $output) {
            $line = [string]$item
            Write-Host $line
            Add-Content -LiteralPath $Report -Value $line
        }
        Log "$Label exit code: $code"
        return $code
    } catch {
        Log "$Label execution error: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        return 999
    }
}

PS>function Test-Endpoint {
    param(
        [string]$BaseUrl,
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Method = "GET"
    )
    $uri = $BaseUrl.TrimEnd("/") + $Path
    try {
        if ($Method -eq "POST") {
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Method POST `
                -ContentType "application/json" -Body "{}" `
                -TimeoutSec 25 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop
        } else {
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Method GET `
                -TimeoutSec 25 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop
        }
        Log "HTTP $($response.StatusCode) $Method $Path"
    } catch {
        $status = $null
        try { $status = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode } catch {}
        if ($status) {
            Log "HTTP $status $Method $Path (server responded; inspect route behavior)"
        } else {
            Log "FAILED $Method $Path : $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}

PS>try {
    Log "SKILLBRIDGE MASTER COMPLETION RUN"
    Log "Project: $Root"
    Log "Report: $Report"

    if (-not (Test-Path $Root)) {
        throw "Project folder not found: $Root. Stop and confirm the existing project path."
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Root "package.json"))) {
        throw "Root package.json not found. No project files were changed."
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Web "package.json"))) {
        throw "apps\web\package.json not found. No project files were changed."
    }

    Set-Location $Root
    Log "`n===== 1. PROJECT AND SOURCE STATUS ====="
    Log "Node: $(& node --version 2>&1)"
    Log "npm: $(& npm --version 2>&1)"

    if (Test-Path ".git") {
        Run-Native "GIT STATUS BEFORE" "git" @("status", "--short") | Out-Null
    } else {
        Log "Git metadata not found at root; skipping Git status."
    }

    Log "`n===== PACKAGE MANAGER / LOCKFILE AUDIT ====="
    foreach ($f in @(
        "package-lock.json", "pnpm-lock.yaml", "yarn.lock",
        "apps\web\package-lock.json", "apps\web\pnpm-lock.yaml"
    )) {
        if (Test-Path (Join-Path $Root $f)) {
            Log "FOUND lockfile: $f"
        }
    }
    Log "Lockfiles are preserved; this run will not delete or regenerate them."

    $pkgPath = Join-Path $Root "package.json"
    $pkg = Get-Content -LiteralPath $pkgPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $engine = [string]$pkg.engines.node
    Log "Root Node engine requirement: $engine"

    if ($engine -eq "22.x") {
        $backup = "$pkgPath.before-engine-fix-$Stamp.bak"
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $pkgPath -Destination $backup
        $pkg.engines.node = ">=22 <27"
        $json = $pkg | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 100
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
            $pkgPath, $json + [Environment]::NewLine,
            [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
        )
        Log "Adjusted the exact Node engine value 22.x to >=22 <27 for Vercel Node 24 compatibility."
        Log "Backup: $backup"
    } else {
        Log "Node engine left unchanged."
    }

    Log "`n===== 2. REQUIRED ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE NAME AUDIT ====="
    $envNames = @(
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL",
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY",
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY",
        "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY",
        "PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY",
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL"
    )

    foreach ($file in @(".env", ".env.local", "apps\web\.env", "apps\web\.env.local")) {
        $full = Join-Path $Root $file
        if (Test-Path $full) {
            $found = @()
            foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $full -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
                if ($line -match '^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=') {
                    $found += $Matches[1]
                }
            }
            foreach ($name in $envNames) {
                if ($found -contains $name) {
                    Log "$file contains variable name: $name (value hidden)"
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Log "Local env files were not printed. Verify production variables in Vercel settings."

    Log "`n===== 3. SUPABASE / PAYSTACK SOURCE AUDIT ====="
    $auditFiles = @(
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-init\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-webhook\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\webhooks\paystack\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\withdraw\route.ts",
        "apps\web\components\TaskWorkspace.tsx"
    )
    foreach ($file in $auditFiles) {
        $full = Join-Path $Root $file
        if (Test-Path $full) {
            Log "SOURCE EXISTS: $file"
            $source = Get-Content -LiteralPath $full -Raw
            if ($file -match "paystack") {
                foreach ($term in @(
                    "PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY",
                    "x-paystack-signature",
                    "createHmac",
                    "charge.success",
                    "paystack_transactions",
                    "status"
                )) {
                    if ($source -match [regex]::Escape($term)) {
                        Log "  payment source contains: $term"
                    } else {
                        Log "  REVIEW payment source for missing/alternate implementation: $term"
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            Log "REVIEW: expected source file not found: $file"
        }
    }
    Log "Source audit is a diagnostic, not proof of secure live payment processing."
    Log "Withdrawal route will not be rewritten automatically."

    Log "`n===== 4. VERCEL CLI / LOGIN ====="
    $Node = (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
    if (-not $Node) { throw "Node.js executable not found on PATH." }

    $Cli = Join-Path $env:APPDATA "npm\node_modules\vercel\dist\vc.js"
    if (-not (Test-Path $Cli)) {
        $vercelCommand = Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($vercelCommand) {
            Log "Using Vercel command on PATH: $($vercelCommand.Source)"
            $whoCode = Run-Native "VERCEL LOGIN CHECK" $vercelCommand.Source @("whoami")
            $Cli = $null
        } else {
            throw "Vercel CLI not found. Install or repair the existing Vercel CLI before deploying."
        }
    } else {
        $whoCode = Run-Native "VERCEL LOGIN CHECK" $Node @($Cli, "whoami")
    }
    if ($whoCode -ne 0) {
        Log "Vercel login check failed. Deployment will not be attempted."
        throw "Authenticate using the existing Vercel CLI, then rerun this script."
    }

    if ($Cli) {
        Run-Native "VERCEL PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENT LIST (NAMES ONLY)" $Node @($Cli, "env", "ls", "production") | Out-Null
    }

    Log "`n===== 5. DEPENDENCY INSTALL DRY RUN ====="
    Run-Native "NPM INSTALL DRY RUN" "npm" @("install", "--dry-run", "--ignore-scripts", "--no-audit", "--no-fund") | Out-Null

    Log "`n===== 6. TYPESCRIPT CHECK IF AVAILABLE ====="
    $webPkg = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Web "package.json") -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $scripts = $webPkg.scripts
    if ($scripts.typecheck) {
        $typeCode = Run-Native "WEB TYPECHECK" "npm" @("--prefix", $Web, "run", "typecheck")
        if ($typeCode -ne 0) { Log "Typecheck reported errors; production build will still provide a separate check." }
    } elseif ($scripts.type-check) {
        $typeCode = Run-Native "WEB TYPE CHECK" "npm" @("--prefix", $Web, "run", "type-check")
        if ($typeCode -ne 0) { Log "Type check reported errors; production build will still provide a separate check." }
    } else {
        Log "No dedicated typecheck script found; relying on the project's build command."
    }

    Log "`n===== 7. PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
    $buildCode = Run-Native "ROOT PRODUCTION BUILD" "npm" @("run", "build")
    if ($buildCode -eq 0) {
        $BuildPassed = $true
        Log "BUILD RESULT: PASS"
    } else {
        Log "BUILD RESULT: FAIL. Deployment skipped to avoid publishing a broken build."
        throw "Production build failed. Review the build errors in this report."
    }

    Log "`n===== 8. DEPLOY EXISTING PROJECT TO VERCEL PRODUCTION ====="
    if (-not $Cli) {
        $deployCode = Run-Native "VERCEL PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT" "vercel" @("deploy", "--prod", "--yes")
    } else {
        $deployCode = Run-Native "VERCEL PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT" $Node @($Cli, "deploy", "--prod", "--yes")
    }
    if ($deployCode -eq 0) {
        $DeployPassed = $true
    }

    Log "`n===== 9. DISCOVER DEPLOYMENT URL ====="
    $reportText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Report -Raw
    $urls = [regex]::Matches($reportText, 'https://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.vercel\.app')
    if ($urls.Count -gt 0) {
        $DeployUrl = $urls[$urls.Count - 1].Value.TrimEnd(".")
        Log "Candidate deployment URL: $DeployUrl"
    } else {
        Log "No Vercel deployment URL detected in CLI output."
    }

    if ($DeployUrl -and $DeployPassed) {
        Log "`n===== 10. LIVE PAGE SMOKE TESTS ====="
        foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/roadmap", "/team")) {
            Test-Endpoint -BaseUrl $DeployUrl -Path $path
        }

        Log "`n===== 11. LIVE API SAFETY / REACHABILITY TESTS ====="
        Test-Endpoint -BaseUrl $DeployUrl -Path "/api/wallet/balance"
        Test-Endpoint -BaseUrl $DeployUrl -Path "/api/paystack-init" -Method "POST"
        Test-Endpoint -BaseUrl $DeployUrl -Path "/api/paystack-webhook" -Method "POST"
        Test-Endpoint -BaseUrl $DeployUrl -Path "/api/webhooks/paystack" -Method "POST"
        Test-Endpoint -BaseUrl $DeployUrl -Path "/api/withdraw" -Method "POST"

        Log "`n===== 12. VERCEL DEPLOYMENT INSPECTION ====="
        if ($Cli) {
            Run-Native "VERCEL INSPECT" $Node @($Cli, "inspect", $DeployUrl) | Out-Null
        } else {
            Run-Native "VERCEL INSPECT" "vercel" @("inspect", $DeployUrl) | Out-Null
        }
    } else {
        Log "Live smoke tests skipped because no successful deployment URL was confirmed."
    }

    Log "`n===== 13. FINAL REPOSITORY STATUS ====="
    if (Test-Path ".git") {
        Run-Native "GIT STATUS AFTER" "git" @("status", "--short") | Out-Null
    }

} catch {
    Log "COMPLETION RUN STOPPED: $($_.Exception.Message)"
} finally {
    Log "`n===== COMPLETION SUMMARY ====="
    Log "Local production build passed: $BuildPassed"
    Log "Vercel deploy command succeeded: $DeployPassed"
    if ($DeployUrl) { Log "Deployment URL candidate: $DeployUrl" }
    Log "Report saved at: $Report"
    Write-Host "`nRun finished. Open the report with:"
    Write-Host "notepad `"$Report`""
}

PS>try {
    Log "===== SKILLBRIDGE FINAL RELEASE CHECK ====="

    if (-not (Test-Path ".\package.json")) {
        Stop-Release "Root package.json not found. No project was recreated."
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path ".\apps\web\package.json")) {
        Stop-Release "apps\web\package.json not found."
    }

    Log "Project files found."
    Log "Git branch: $(git branch --show-current)"
    git diff --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Stop-Release "Git whitespace/conflict check failed."
    }

    Log "===== TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION ====="
    $tscPath = $null
    if (Test-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tscPath = (Resolve-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    } elseif (Test-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tscPath = (Resolve-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    }

    if ($tscPath -and (Test-Path ".\apps\web\tsconfig.json")) {
        Push-Location ".\apps\web"
        try {
            & $tscPath --noEmit
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                Stop-Release "TypeScript validation failed."
            }
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
        Log "TypeScript validation PASSED."
    } else {
        Log "TypeScript check skipped: compiler or web tsconfig unavailable."
    }

    Log "===== LINT SCRIPT CHECK ====="
    $rootPkg = Get-Content ".\package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $webPkg = Get-Content ".\apps\web\package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ($webPkg.scripts.lint) {
        Push-Location ".\apps\web"
        try {
            npm run lint
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                Stop-Release "Web lint failed."
            }
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
        Log "Web lint PASSED."
    } elseif ($rootPkg.scripts.lint) {
        npm run lint
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Stop-Release "Root lint failed."
        }
        Log "Root lint PASSED."
    } else {
        Log "Lint NOT RUN: this project has no existing lint script."
    }

    Log "===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
    npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Stop-Release "Production build failed. Deployment cancelled."
    }
    Log "Production build PASSED."

    Log "===== EXISTING VERCEL PROJECT CHECK ====="
    if (-not (Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        Stop-Release "Vercel CLI is unavailable."
    }

    vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Stop-Release "Vercel login is required."
    }

    $linked = (Test-Path ".\apps\web\.vercel\project.json") -or
              (Test-Path ".\.vercel\project.json")

    if (-not $linked) {
        Stop-Release "No existing Vercel project link found at the expected paths. Link the existing project before deploying; do not create a new one."
    }

    Log "Existing Vercel link detected. Deploying the existing web app."
    Push-Location ".\apps\web"
    try {
        vercel --prod --yes
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Stop-Release "Vercel production deployment failed."
        }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }

    Log "Vercel deployment command completed."

    Log "===== PRODUCTION PAGE SMOKE TESTS ====="
    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    $paths = @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team", "/rider/dashboard")

    foreach ($path in $paths) {
        $url = "$base$path"
        try {
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 25
            Log "HTTP $([int]$response.StatusCode) $url"
        } catch {
            $status = "Request failed or access is protected"
            if ($_.Exception.Response -and $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode) {
                $status = "HTTP $([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode)"
            }
            Log "$status $url"
        }
    }

    Log "===== SECURITY REMINDERS ====="
    Log "Environment files and secrets were not printed or committed by this script."
    Log "No real payment was initiated."
    Log "Paystack webhook signature, wallet crediting, task submission, uploads and withdrawals still require authenticated end-to-end testing."
    Log "===== RELEASE CHECK FINISHED ====="
    Log "Report saved to: $report"
    Write-Host "`nReport: $report" -ForegroundColor Green

} catch {
    Write-Host "`nRELEASE STOPPED: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Read the last lines of the release report before proceeding." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

PS>function Log([string]$Message) {

    Write-Host $line
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $line

PS>try {
    Log "===== SKILLBRIDGE DEPLOYMENT ====="

    if (!(Test-Path ".\package.json") -or !(Test-Path ".\apps\web\package.json")) {
        throw "Existing project files are missing. Stopping without recreating anything."
    }

    Log "===== CHECK SOURCE CHANGES ====="
    git diff --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git diff check failed." }

    Log "===== TYPESCRIPT ====="
    $tscPath = $null
    if (Test-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tscPath = (Resolve-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    } elseif (Test-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tscPath = (Resolve-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    }

    if ($tscPath -and (Test-Path ".\apps\web\tsconfig.json")) {
        Push-Location ".\apps\web"
        try {
            & $tscPath --noEmit
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "TypeScript validation failed." }
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
        Log "TypeScript validation PASSED."
    } else {
        Log "TypeScript validation skipped: compiler or tsconfig unavailable."
    }

    Log "===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
    npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Production build failed; deployment cancelled." }
    Log "Production build PASSED."

    Log "===== VERCEL LOGIN ====="
    if (!(Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "Vercel CLI is unavailable."
    }
    vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel login failed. Sign in and rerun." }

    $linkedPaths = @(
        ".\apps\web\.vercel\project.json",
        ".\.vercel\project.json"
    )
    $linked = $false
    foreach ($item in $linkedPaths) {
        if (Test-Path $item) { $linked = $true }
    }
    if (!$linked) {
        throw "No existing Vercel project link was found. Stopping to avoid creating or deploying to the wrong project."
    }

    Log "Existing Vercel project link detected."
    Log "===== DEPLOY PRODUCTION ====="
    Push-Location ".\apps\web"
    try {
        vercel --prod --yes
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel deployment failed. Check the error above." }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
    Log "Vercel production deployment command succeeded."

    Log "===== LIVE PAGE CHECKS ====="
    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
        try {
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base + $path) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30
            Log ("HTTP " + [int]$response.StatusCode + " " + $path)
        } catch {
            $status = "Request failed"
            if ($_.Exception.Response -and $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode) {
                $status = "HTTP " + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            Log ($status + " " + $path + " (may require Vercel authentication)")
        }
    }

    Log "===== FINAL STATUS ====="
    Log "Build and deployment command completed."
    Log "Live-page checks do not verify authenticated database or payment workflows."
    Log "Paystack payments, wallet crediting, submissions, uploads and withdrawals still need end-to-end verification."
    Log ("Report: " + $report)
    Write-Host "`nDeployment run finished. Report: $report" -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Log ("STOPPED: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Write-Host "`nSTOPPED: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Use the error above to continue fixing the existing project; do not recreate it." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

PS>function Log([string]$Message) {
    $line = "$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') $Message"
    Write-Host $line
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $line
}

PS>function Require-File([string]$Path) {
    if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {
        Log "MISSING REQUIRED FILE: $Path"
        return $false
    }
    Log "FOUND: $Path"
    return $true
}

PS>try {
    Log "===== SKILLBRIDGE RELEASE COMPLETION PASS ====="

    if (!(Require-File "package.json")) { throw "Root package.json is missing." }
    if (!(Require-File "apps/web/package.json")) { throw "Web package.json is missing." }

    Log "===== GIT SAFETY CHECK ====="
    git diff --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git diff check failed. Resolve the reported issue first." }
    Log "Git whitespace/conflict check passed."
    Log ("Current branch: " + (git branch --show-current))
    Log "Existing source changes will be preserved; nothing will be committed or reset."

    Log "===== REQUIRED FEATURE FILES ====="
    $requiredFiles = @(
        "apps/web/app/api/paystack-init/route.ts",
        "apps/web/app/api/paystack-webhook/route.ts",
        "apps/web/app/api/webhooks/paystack/route.ts",
        "apps/web/app/api/withdraw/route.ts",
        "apps/web/components/PaystackCheckoutButton.tsx",
        "apps/web/components/TaskWorkspace.tsx",
        "apps/web/components/WalletBalanceDisplay.tsx",
        "apps/web/components/WithdrawalForm.tsx",
        "supabase/migrations/20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql"
    )

    $missingRequired = @()
    foreach ($file in $requiredFiles) {
        if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) {
            $missingRequired += $file
            Log "MISSING: $file"
        } else {
            Log "FOUND: $file"
        }
    }

    if ($missingRequired.Count -gt 0) {
        Log "Some expected payment/task files are missing. Review report before production release."
    }

    Log "===== PAYMENT SECURITY SOURCE CHECK ====="
    $initFile = "apps/web/app/api/paystack-init/route.ts"
    $hookFile = "apps/web/app/api/paystack-webhook/route.ts"
    $hook2File = "apps/web/app/api/webhooks/paystack/route.ts"

    if (Test-Path $initFile) {
        $initText = Get-Content $initFile -Raw
        foreach ($check in @(
            @{ Name = "Paystack API URL"; Pattern = "api\.paystack\.co/transaction/initialize" },
            @{ Name = "Authenticated user lookup"; Pattern = "auth\.getUser" },
            @{ Name = "Transaction reference"; Pattern = "reference" },
            @{ Name = "GHS currency"; Pattern = "GHS" }
        )) {
            if ($initText -match $check.Pattern) {
                Log ("PASS source indicator: " + $check.Name)
            } else {
                Log ("REVIEW source indicator missing: " + $check.Name)
            }
        }
        if ($initText -match "DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY|dodopayments\.com") {
            Log "WARNING: Legacy Dodo initialization references remain in the Paystack initialization file."
        }
    }

    foreach ($hook in @($hookFile, $hook2File)) {
        if (Test-Path $hook) {
            $hookText = Get-Content $hook -Raw
            Log ("Webhook source review: " + $hook)
            if ($hookText -match "x-paystack-signature") {
                Log "PASS source indicator: Paystack signature header"
            } else {
                Log "REVIEW: signature header check not found"
            }
            if ($hookText -match "createHmac|create-hmac|timingSafeEqual") {
                Log "PASS source indicator: HMAC/signature verification implementation indicator"
            } else {
                Log "REVIEW: explicit HMAC verification indicator not found"
            }
            if ($hookText -match "charge\.success") {
                Log "PASS source indicator: charge.success event"
            } else {
                Log "REVIEW: charge.success event handler not found"
            }
            if ($hookText -match "credit_paystack_wallet|credit.*wallet|wallet.*credit") {
                Log "Wallet-credit indicator found; database behavior still needs a real test payment."
            } else {
                Log "REVIEW: wallet-credit indicator not found in this webhook file."
            }
        }
    }

    Log "===== TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION ====="
    $tscPath = $null
    if (Test-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tscPath = (Resolve-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    } elseif (Test-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tscPath = (Resolve-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    }

    if ($tscPath -and (Test-Path ".\apps\web\tsconfig.json")) {
        Push-Location ".\apps\web"
        try {
            & $tscPath --noEmit
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "TypeScript validation failed; deployment cancelled." }
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
        Log "TypeScript validation PASSED."
    } else {
        throw "TypeScript compiler or apps/web/tsconfig.json is missing. Cannot safely continue."
    }

    Log "===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
    npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Production build failed; deployment cancelled." }
    Log "Production build PASSED."

    Log "===== EXISTING VERCEL PROJECT CHECK ====="
    if (!(Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "Vercel CLI is unavailable."
    }

    vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel login required. Sign in, then rerun." }

    $linked = (Test-Path ".\apps\web\.vercel\project.json") -or
              (Test-Path ".\.vercel\project.json")

    if (!$linked) {
        throw "Existing Vercel project link not found in the expected locations. Stopping to avoid creating or deploying to the wrong project."
    }

    Log "Existing Vercel project link detected."

    Log "===== DEPLOY PRODUCTION ====="
    Push-Location ".\apps\web"
    try {
        vercel --prod --yes
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Production deployment failed. Read the Vercel CLI error." }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
    Log "Production deployment command succeeded."

    Log "===== LIVE ROUTE CHECKS ====="
    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
        try {
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base + $path) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30
            Log ("HTTP " + [int]$response.StatusCode + " " + $path)
        } catch {
            $status = "Request failed or access is protected"
            if ($_.Exception.Response -and $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode) {
                $status = "HTTP " + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            Log ($status + " " + $path)
        }
    }

    Log "===== FINAL LIMITATIONS ====="
    Log "Live page responses do not prove authenticated database operations."
    Log "A source-pattern check is not proof that webhook signature validation or wallet crediting is correct."
    Log "Task submissions, file uploads, Paystack test payments, duplicate-webhook handling, and withdrawals require authenticated end-to-end tests."
    Log ("Report saved to: " + $report)

    Write-Host "`nRELEASE PASS FINISHED. Report: $report" -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Log ("RELEASE STOPPED: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Write-Host "`nRELEASE STOPPED: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Use the report path printed below to identify the blocker." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "Report: $report"
}

PS>function Log([string]$Message) {
    $line = "$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') $Message"
    Write-Host $line
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $line
}

PS>try {
    Log "===== SKILLBRIDGE RECOVERY ====="

    if (!(Test-Path ".\package.json") -or !(Test-Path ".\apps\web\package.json")) {
        throw "Existing project files are missing. Nothing was recreated."
    }

    git diff --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git diff check failed." }

    if (!(Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "Vercel CLI not found."
    }
    vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel login failed." }

    Log "===== CHECK PRODUCTION CONFIGURATION NAMES ====="
    Push-Location ".\apps\web"
    try {
        vercel env ls production
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Log "Could not list production environment variable names."
        }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }

    Log "===== SUPABASE MIGRATION PREFLIGHT ====="
    $migration = ".\supabase\migrations\20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql"
    $supabaseCli = Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $dbReady = $false

    if (!(Test-Path $migration)) {
        Log "BLOCKED: Expected migration file not found: $migration"
    } elseif (!$supabaseCli) {
        Log "BLOCKED: Supabase CLI is not installed; migration was not applied."
    } elseif (!(Test-Path ".\supabase\config.toml")) {
        Log "BLOCKED: Supabase config.toml is missing; refusing to guess the database project."
    } else {
        $sql = Get-Content $migration -Raw
        $sqlForCheck = [regex]::Replace($sql, '(?s)/\*.*?\*/', '')
        $sqlForCheck = [regex]::Replace($sqlForCheck, '(?m)--.*$', '')

        if ($sqlForCheck -match '(?i)\b(DROP\s+TABLE|DROP\s+COLUMN|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|DELETE\s+FROM|DROP\s+SCHEMA)\b') {
            Log "BLOCKED: Migration contains a destructive SQL operation. Review it before applying."
        } else {
            Push-Location ".\apps\web"
            try {
                vercel env pull $tempEnv --environment=production
                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                    Log "BLOCKED: Could not retrieve production environment configuration for project matching."
                } else {
                    $envText = Get-Content $tempEnv -Raw
                    $urlMatch = [regex]::Match($envText, '(?m)^\s*NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL\s*=\s*["'']?(https://[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.supabase\.co)')
                    $prodRef = if ($urlMatch.Success) { $urlMatch.Groups[1].Value -replace '^https://','' -replace '\.supabase\.co$','' } else { $null }
                    $linkedRefFile = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path "..\..\supabase\.temp\project-ref"
                    $linkedRefFile = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($linkedRefFile)
                    $linkedRef = if (Test-Path $linkedRefFile) { (Get-Content $linkedRefFile -Raw).Trim() } else { $null }

                    if (!$prodRef -or !$linkedRef -or $prodRef -ne $linkedRef) {
                        Log "BLOCKED: Production Supabase project could not be matched to the linked CLI project. No database changes made."
                    } else {
                        Log "Production Supabase project matches the linked CLI project."
                        Push-Location "..\.."
                        try {
                            supabase migration list --linked
                            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                                Log "BLOCKED: Could not read linked migration status."
                            } else {
                                supabase db push --linked --dry-run
                                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                                    Log "BLOCKED: Supabase migration dry-run failed. No migration applied."
                                } else {
                                    supabase db push --linked --yes
                                    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
                                        Log "Supabase migration push succeeded."
                                        $dbReady = $true
                                    } else {
                                        Log "BLOCKED: Supabase migration push failed. Inspect the Supabase CLI output."
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } finally {
                            Pop-Location
                        }
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                Pop-Location
            }
        }
    }

    Log "===== TYPESCRIPT AND BUILD ====="
    $tsc = $null
    if (Test-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tsc = (Resolve-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    } elseif (Test-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tsc = (Resolve-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    }

    if ($tsc -and (Test-Path ".\apps\web\tsconfig.json")) {
        Push-Location ".\apps\web"
        try {
            & $tsc --noEmit
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "TypeScript check failed; deployment stopped." }
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }
        Log "TypeScript check passed."
    } else {
        throw "TypeScript compiler or web tsconfig missing."
    }

    npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Production build failed; deployment stopped." }
    Log "Production build passed."

    Log "===== RETRY EXISTING VERCEL DEPLOYMENT ====="
    $linked = (Test-Path ".\apps\web\.vercel\project.json") -or (Test-Path ".\.vercel\project.json")
    if (!$linked) { throw "Existing Vercel project link not found. No new project will be created." }

    $deployed = $false
    for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 3; $attempt++) {
        Log "Vercel deployment attempt $attempt of 3."
        Push-Location ".\apps\web"
        try {
            vercel --prod --yes
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
                $deployed = $true
                break
            }
        } catch {
            Log ("Deployment attempt error: " + $_.Exception.Message)
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }

        if ($attempt -lt 3) {
            Log "Deployment attempt failed; waiting 15 seconds before retry."
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 15
        }
    }

    if (!$deployed) {
        throw "All three Vercel deployment attempts failed. Check network access and the Vercel status page, then rerun."
    }

    Log "Vercel production deployment succeeded."

    Log "===== LIVE PAGE SMOKE TESTS ====="
    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
        try {
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base + $path) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30
            Log ("HTTP " + [int]$response.StatusCode + " " + $path)
        } catch {
            $status = "Request failed or deployment protection is enabled"
            if ($_.Exception.Response -and $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode) {
                $status = "HTTP " + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            Log ($status + " " + $path)
        }
    }

    Log "===== PAYMENT ACCEPTANCE LIMITS ====="
    Log "No real charge was initiated by this script."
    Log "A live Paystack test payment, authenticated learner submission, duplicate webhook replay, invalid-signature test, and withdrawal test still need verified test credentials and an authenticated test account."
    Log ("Supabase migration applied by this run: " + $dbReady)
    Log ("Report: " + $report)
    Write-Host "`nRECOVERY PASS FINISHED. Report: $report" -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Log ("STOPPED: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Write-Host "`nSTOPPED: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Report: $report" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

    Log "===== EXISTING PROJECT ====="

    Log "===== PRIOR RELEASE REPORT ====="
    $prior = Get-ChildItem ".\release-reports" -Filter "recovery-*.txt" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

    if ($prior) {
        Log ("Prior report: " + $prior.FullName)
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $prior.FullName -Tail 25 |
            ForEach-Object { Log ("PRIOR: " + $_) }

        Log "No previous recovery report found."
    }

    Log "===== REQUIRED FEATURE FILES ====="
    $files = @(

    )
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        if (Test-Path $f) { Log "FOUND $f" } else { Log "MISSING $f" }
    }

    Log "===== TYPESCRIPT ====="
    $tsc = $null
    if (Test-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tsc = (Resolve-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    } elseif (Test-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd") {
        $tsc = (Resolve-Path ".\apps\web\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd").Path
    }
    if (!$tsc -or !(Test-Path ".\apps\web\tsconfig.json")) {
        throw "TypeScript compiler or web tsconfig missing."
    }

    Push-Location ".\apps\web"
    & $tsc --noEmit
    $tscExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($tscExit -ne 0) { throw "TypeScript validation failed." }
    Log "TypeScript PASSED."

    Log "===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
    npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Production build failed." }
    Log "Production build PASSED."

    Log "===== VERCEL EXISTING PROJECT ====="
    if (!(Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "Vercel CLI not installed."
    }
    vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel login failed." }

    $link = $null
    foreach ($p in @(".\apps\web\.vercel\project.json", ".\.vercel\project.json")) {
        if (Test-Path $p) { $link = $p; break }
    }
    if (!$link) { throw "Existing Vercel project link not found; refusing to create a new project." }
    Log ("Existing Vercel link: " + $link)

    Log "===== RETRY PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT ====="
    $deployOK = $false
    for ($i = 1; $i -le 3; $i++) {
        Log ("Deployment attempt " + $i + " of 3")
        Push-Location ".\apps\web"
        vercel --prod --yes
        $deployExit = $LASTEXITCODE
        Pop-Location

        if ($deployExit -eq 0) {
            $deployOK = $true
            break
        }

        if ($i -lt 3) {
            Log "Deployment attempt failed; waiting 15 seconds before retry."
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 15
        }
    }

    if (!$deployOK) {
        Log "DEPLOYMENT BLOCKED: Vercel deployment failed on all attempts. Check network connectivity and Vercel service status."
    } else {
        Log "Production deployment command succeeded."
    }

    Log "===== LIVE ROUTE TESTS ====="
    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
        try {
            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base + $path) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 25
            Log ("HTTP " + [int]$r.StatusCode + " " + $path)
        } catch {
            $status = "request failed or deployment protected"
            if ($_.Exception.Response -and $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode) {
                $status = "HTTP " + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            Log ($status + " " + $path)
        }
    }

    Log "===== SUPABASE MIGRATION STATUS ====="
    if (Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        if (Test-Path ".\supabase\config.toml") {
            Push-Location "."
            supabase migration list --linked
            Log ("Supabase migration list exit code: " + $LASTEXITCODE)
            Pop-Location
            Log "No migration was automatically applied by this script."
        } else {
            Log "BLOCKED: Supabase config.toml not found; database project cannot be safely identified."
        }
    } else {
        Log "BLOCKED: Supabase CLI not installed; migration status not verified."
    }

    Log "===== PAYSTACK SOURCE INDICATORS ====="
    foreach ($p in @(
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-webhook\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\webhooks\paystack\route.ts"
    )) {
        if (Test-Path $p) {
            $body = Get-Content $p -Raw
            Log ("Reviewing " + $p)
            Log ("Signature header indicator: " + [bool]($body -match "x-paystack-signature"))
            Log ("HMAC indicator: " + [bool]($body -match "createHmac|timingSafeEqual"))
            Log ("charge.success indicator: " + [bool]($body -match "charge\.success"))
            Log ("Wallet credit indicator: " + [bool]($body -match "credit_paystack_wallet|credit.*wallet|wallet.*credit"))
        }
    }

    Log "===== END-TO-END ACCEPTANCE STATUS ====="

    Log ("Report saved: " + $report)

    Write-Host "`nSINGLE-PASS RUN FINISHED. Report: $report" -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Log ("STOPPED: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Write-Host "`nRUN STOPPED: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ("Report: " + $report) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

PS>try {
    Log "===== SKILLBRIDGE MIGRATION AND RELEASE ====="

    if (!(Test-Path ".\package.json") -or
        !(Test-Path ".\apps\web\package.json") -or
        !(Test-Path ".\supabase\migrations\20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql")) {
        throw "Required existing project or migration file missing."
    }

    if (!(Test-Path ".\supabase\config.toml")) {
        throw "supabase/config.toml is missing. Stopping rather than guessing project configuration."
    }

    git diff --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git whitespace/conflict check failed." }

    Log "===== INSTALL LOCAL SUPABASE CLI IF NEEDED ====="
    $cliInstalled = Test-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\supabase.cmd"
    if (!$cliInstalled) {
        npm install --save-dev supabase
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Could not install Supabase CLI as a local development dependency." }
    }

    $supabase = (Resolve-Path ".\node_modules\.bin\supabase.cmd").Path
    & $supabase --version
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Supabase CLI could not run." }

    Log "===== VERIFY EXISTING VERCEL PROJECT ====="
    if (!(Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "Vercel CLI is unavailable."
    }
    vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel login required." }

    Push-Location ".\apps\web"
    try {
        vercel env pull $tempEnv --environment=production
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Could not read production environment configuration. Migration stopped." }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }

    $envText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tempEnv -Raw
    $match = [regex]::Match(
        $envText,
        '(?m)^\s*NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL\s*=\s*["'']?(https://[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.supabase\.co)'
    )
    $productionRef = if ($match.Success) {
        ($match.Groups[1].Value -replace '^https://','' -replace '\.supabase\.co$','')
    } else {
        $null
    }

    if (!$productionRef) {
        throw "Could not determine production Supabase project ID from its URL. No database changes made."
    }
    Log "Production Supabase project ID identified; URL and secrets will not be printed."

    Log "===== VERIFY SUPABASE LOGIN ====="
    & $supabase projects list
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Supabase CLI is not authenticated. Run supabase login in this terminal, then rerun this complete block."
    }

    $refFile = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path "supabase\.temp\project-ref"
    $linkedRef = if (Test-Path $refFile) { (Get-Content $refFile -Raw).Trim() } else { $null }

    if ($linkedRef -and $linkedRef -ne $productionRef) {
        throw "Linked Supabase project differs from production. No migration applied; correct the project link first."
    }

    if (!$linkedRef) {
        Log "Linking Supabase CLI to the project identified from the production URL."
        & $supabase link --project-ref $productionRef
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Supabase project linking failed. If prompted, enter the database password only in this terminal."
        }
    }

    Log "===== CHECK MIGRATION SQL SAFETY ====="
    $migration = Get-Content ".\supabase\migrations\20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql" -Raw
    $sqlCheck = [regex]::Replace($migration, '(?s)/\*.*?\*/', '')
    $sqlCheck = [regex]::Replace($sqlCheck, '(?m)--.*$', '')

    if ($sqlCheck -match '(?i)\b(DROP\s+TABLE|DROP\s+COLUMN|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|DELETE\s+FROM|DROP\s+SCHEMA)\b') {
        throw "Migration contains a potentially destructive SQL statement. Review the migration before applying it."
    }

    Log "===== CHECK REMOTE MIGRATION STATUS ====="
    & $supabase migration list --linked
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Could not read remote migration history." }

    Log "===== PREVIEW PENDING MIGRATIONS ====="
    & $supabase db push --linked --dry-run
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Migration preview failed. No migration was applied." }

    Log "===== APPLY VERIFIED MIGRATIONS ====="
    & $supabase db push --linked --yes
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Migration push failed. Review Supabase CLI output." }
    Log "Supabase migration push completed."

    Log "===== VERIFY REMOTE MIGRATION HISTORY ====="
    & $supabase migration list --linked
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Could not verify migration history after the push." }

    Log "===== CHECK LIVE DEPLOYMENT ====="
    foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
        try {
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ("https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app" + $path) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 25
            Log ("HTTP " + [int]$response.StatusCode + " " + $path)
        } catch {
            $status = "Request failed or Vercel protection is enabled"
            if ($_.Exception.Response -and $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode) {
                $status = "HTTP " + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            Log ($status + " " + $path)
        }
    }

    Log "===== ACCEPTANCE TEST STATUS ====="
    Log "Build and production deployment were confirmed in the previous run."
    Log "Migration push and migration-history output were checked by this run."
    Log "A successful migration does not prove learner authentication, task uploads, wallet crediting, webhook replay protection, or withdrawals work end to end."
    Log "No real payment or withdrawal was initiated."
    Log ("Report: " + $report)

    Write-Host "`nMIGRATION RELEASE PASS FINISHED. Report: $report" -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Log ("BLOCKED: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Write-Host "`nRELEASE BLOCKED: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Report: $report" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

  $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
  Set-Location "$HOME\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix"

  $root = (Get-Location).Path
  $web = Join-Path $root "apps\web"
  $migration = Join-Path $root "supabase\migrations\20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql"
  $reportDir = Join-Path $root "release-reports"
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null
  $report = Join-Path $reportDir ("skillbridge-final-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + ".txt")

  function Log([string]$Message) {
    Write-Host $Message
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $Message
  }

  try {
    Log "===== SKILLBRIDGE CONTINUATION CHECK ====="
    Log "Project: $root"
    Log "Started: $(Get-Date -Format o)"

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $web "package.json"))) {
      throw "apps\web\package.json is missing. No deployment attempted."
    }
    if (!(Test-Path $migration)) {
      Log "BLOCKED: Expected Supabase migration file was not found."
      throw "Migration file missing; database changes were not attempted."
    }

    Log "`n===== GIT WHITESPACE CHECK ====="
    & git diff --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
      throw "git diff --check failed. Review existing changes before deployment."
    }

    Log "`n===== SUPABASE CLI CHECK ====="
    $supabase = Join-Path $root "node_modules\.bin\supabase.cmd"
    if (!(Test-Path $supabase)) {
      $found = Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      if ($found) { $supabase = $found.Source }
      else {
        Log "BLOCKED: Supabase CLI is not installed in this project or PATH."
        Log "Install it using the official Supabase CLI instructions, then rerun this block."
        throw "Supabase CLI unavailable; database migration was not applied."
      }
    }
    & $supabase --version
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Supabase CLI could not run." }

    Log "`n===== MIGRATION SAFETY SCREEN ====="
    $sql = Get-Content -LiteralPath $migration -Raw
    $sqlForCheck = [regex]::Replace($sql, '(?s)/\*.*?\*/|--[^\r\n]*', '')
    if ($sqlForCheck -match '(?i)\bDROP\s+(TABLE|COLUMN|SCHEMA|DATABASE)\b|\bTRUNCATE\s+TABLE\b|\bDELETE\s+FROM\b') {
      Log "BLOCKED: Migration contains a destructive SQL pattern; it was not applied."
      throw "Manual review of the migration is required before database changes."
    }
    Log "Basic destructive-pattern screen passed. This is not a full SQL audit."

    Log "`n===== SUPABASE AUTHENTICATION CHECK ====="
    & $supabase projects list
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
      Log "BLOCKED: Supabase CLI login is required."
      throw "Run supabase login in the terminal, finish its secure sign-in flow, then rerun this complete block."
    }

    Log "`n===== LINKED PROJECT CHECK ====="
    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $root "supabase\config.toml"))) {
      Log "BLOCKED: supabase\config.toml is missing."
      throw "Existing Supabase configuration needs inspection; no migration was applied."
    }

    & $supabase migration list --linked
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
      throw "Could not verify linked Supabase migration history. No migration was pushed."
    }

    Log "`n===== TYPE SCRIPT CHECK ====="
    Push-Location $web
    try {
      & npm exec -- tsc --noEmit
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "TypeScript validation failed." }
    } finally {
      Pop-Location
    }

    Log "`n===== PRODUCTION BUILD ====="
    & npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Production build failed. Deployment skipped." }

    Log "`n===== DEPLOY EXISTING VERCEL PROJECT ====="
    & vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel login is required. Deployment skipped." }

    & vercel --prod --yes
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel production deployment failed." }

    Log "`n===== DEPLOYMENT FINISHED ====="
    Log "Build and deployment commands completed successfully."
    Log "Database migration was NOT pushed by this script; verify its SQL and deployment-specific database changes separately."
    Log "Live URL: https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
  }
  catch {
    Log ("STOPPED SAFELY: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    Log "Fix the specific blocker shown above, then rerun the full block."
  }
  finally {
    Log "Report: $report"
  }
}

  $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
  Set-Location "$HOME\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix"

  $root = (Get-Location).Path
  $web = Join-Path $root "apps\web"
  $reportDir = Join-Path $root "release-reports"
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null
  $report = Join-Path $reportDir ("skillbridge-finish-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + ".txt")

  function Log([string]$s) {
    Write-Host $s
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $s
  }

  try {
    Log "=== SKILLBRIDGE FINAL PRODUCTION RUN ==="
    Log "Folder: $root"

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $web "package.json"))) {
      throw "Existing web project not found. No files changed."
    }

    Log "`n=== GIT CHECK ==="
    git status --short
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git status failed." }
    git diff --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git diff check failed." }

    Log "`n=== VERCEL PROJECT CHECK ==="
    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $root ".vercel\project.json"))) {
      throw "Existing Vercel link is missing; refusing to deploy to an unverified project."
    }
    vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Sign in to Vercel in this terminal, then rerun." }

    Log "`n=== DEPENDENCY CHECK ==="
    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $root "node_modules"))) {
      npm install
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Root dependency installation failed." }
    }
    Push-Location $web
    try {
      if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $web "node_modules"))) {
        npm install
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Web dependency installation failed." }
      }

      Log "`n=== TYPESCRIPT CHECK ==="
      npm exec -- tsc --noEmit
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "TypeScript reported errors. See output above." }
    } finally {
      Pop-Location
    }

    Log "`n=== SUPABASE MIGRATION CHECK ==="
    $supabase = Join-Path $root "node_modules\.bin\supabase.cmd"
    if (!(Test-Path $supabase)) {
      $globalSupabase = Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      if ($globalSupabase) { $supabase = $globalSupabase.Source }
    }

    if ((Test-Path $supabase) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $root "supabase\config.toml"))) {
      & $supabase migration list --linked
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Log "Supabase migration status could not be verified. No database changes made."
      } else {
        Log "Migration history displayed above; confirm the intended production migration is applied."
      }
    } else {
      Log "Supabase CLI or config is missing. Database status remains unverified; no database changes made."
    }

    Log "`n=== PRODUCTION BUILD ==="
    npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Production build failed. Review the first reported build error." }

    Log "`n=== DEPLOY EXISTING VERCEL PROJECT ==="
    vercel --prod --yes
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Production deployment failed. Review the Vercel error above." }

    Log "`n=== LIVE ROUTE CHECK ==="
    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
      try {
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base + $path) -Method Get -MaximumRedirection 0 -TimeoutSec 25 -SkipHttpErrorCheck
        Log "$path => HTTP $([int]$r.StatusCode)"
      } catch {
        Log "$path => CHECK FAILED: $($_.Exception.Message)"
      }
    }

    Log "`n=== RUN COMPLETE ==="
    Log "Build and deployment commands passed if no failure was reported above."
    Log "This does not prove real Paystack transactions, wallet credits, withdrawals, or task submissions have passed end-to-end testing."
  }
  catch {
    Log ("BLOCKER: " + $_.Exception.Message)
  }
  finally {
    Log "Report saved to: $report"
  }
}

PS>& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
    Set-Location "$HOME\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix"

    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    $deployment = "skillbridge-7rmqfom7g-link-the-ink.vercel.app"
    $reportDir = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path "release-reports"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null
    $report = Join-Path $reportDir ("skillbridge-final-audit-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + ".txt")

    function Log([string]$Message) {
        Write-Host $Message
        Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $Message
    }

    Log "===== SKILLBRIDGE POST-DEPLOYMENT AUDIT ====="
    Log "Alias: $base"
    Log "Deployment: $deployment"

    Log "`n===== DEPLOYMENT DETAILS AND LOGS ====="
    vercel inspect $deployment --logs 2>&1 |
        ForEach-Object { Log ([string]$_) }

    Log "`n===== LIVE HTTP ROUTE CHECK ====="
    $handler = [System.Net.Http.HttpClientHandler]::new()
    $handler.AllowAutoRedirect = $false
    $client = [System.Net.Http.HttpClient]::new($handler)
    $client.Timeout = [TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(25)

    foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
        try {
            $response = $client.GetAsync($base + $path).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
            $status = [int]$response.StatusCode
            Log "$path => HTTP $status"
            $response.Dispose()
        }
        catch {
            Log "$path => REQUEST ERROR: $($_.Exception.GetBaseException().Message)"
        }
    }

    $client.Dispose()
    $handler.Dispose()

    Log "`n===== PAYSTACK AND TASK FILE INVENTORY ====="
    $files = @(
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-init\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-webhook\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\webhooks\paystack\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\webhooks\dodo\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\withdraw\route.ts",
        "apps\web\components\TaskWorkspace.tsx",
        "apps\web\app\api\wallet\balance\route.ts",
        "supabase\migrations\20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql"
    )

    foreach ($file in $files) {
        if (Test-Path $file) {
            Log "FOUND: $file"
        } else {
            Log "MISSING: $file"
        }
    }

    Log "`n===== SUPABASE MIGRATION STATUS ====="
    $cli = Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cli -and (Test-Path "supabase\config.toml")) {
        supabase migration list --linked 2>&1 |
            ForEach-Object { Log ([string]$_) }
        Log "Review the migration list and confirm the intended production project."
    } else {
        Log "UNVERIFIED: Supabase CLI or supabase\config.toml is missing."
        Log "No database changes were made."
    }

    Log "`n===== AUDIT REPORT ====="
    Log "Saved to: $report"
    Log "This audit does not itself prove payment, wallet, withdrawal, or submission flows work."
}

PS>& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
    Set-Location "$HOME\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix"

    $reportDir = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path "release-reports"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null
    $report = Join-Path $reportDir ("skillbridge-completion-evidence-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + ".txt")

    function Out([string]$s) {
        Write-Host $s
        Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $s
    }

    Out "===== SKILLBRIDGE COMPLETION EVIDENCE ====="
    Out "Project: $((Get-Location).Path)"
    Out "`n===== GIT CHANGES ====="
    git status --short 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Out ([string]$_) }

    $targets = @(
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-init\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-webhook\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\webhooks\paystack\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\webhooks\dodo\route.ts",
        "apps\web\components\TaskWorkspace.tsx",
        "apps\web\app\api\wallet\balance\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\withdraw\route.ts",
        "supabase\migrations\20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql"
    )

    foreach ($file in $targets) {
        Out "`n===== FILE: $file ====="
        if (Test-Path $file) {
            $lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath $file
            Out "Lines: $($lines.Count)"
            if ($file -like "*withdraw*") {
                Out "Withdrawal source intentionally not printed; route will be preserved."
                continue
            }
            if ($lines.Count -le 240) {
                $lines | ForEach-Object { Out ([string]$_) }
            } else {
                Out "File is long; relevant references follow."
                Select-String -LiteralPath $file -Pattern `
                    "create table|alter table|create or replace function|create policy|grant execute|paystack|reference|status|credit_|task_submissions|storage|submissionText|submission_text|upload|authorization|signature|charge.success|dodo" `
                    -Context 2,3 |
                    ForEach-Object { Out ([string]$_) }
            }
        } else {
            Out "MISSING"
        }
    }

    Out "`n===== ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE NAMES ONLY ====="
    $envFiles = @(
        "apps\web\.env.example",
        "apps\web\.env.local.example",
        ".env.example",
        ".env.production.example"
    )
    foreach ($file in $envFiles) {
        if (Test-Path $file) {
            Out "Found $file"
            Select-String -LiteralPath $file -Pattern "^[\s]*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*=" |
                ForEach-Object {
                    $name = ($_.Line -split "=",2)[0].Trim()
                    Out "  $name"
                }
        }
    }

    Out "`n===== DATABASE CLI STATUS ====="
    if (Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        supabase --version 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Out ([string]$_) }
        if (Test-Path "supabase\config.toml") {
            supabase migration list --linked 2>&1 |
                ForEach-Object { Out ([string]$_) }
        } else {
            Out "supabase\config.toml missing; linked migration status not checked."
        }
    } else {
        Out "Supabase CLI unavailable; database migration status remains unverified."
    }

    Out "`n===== EVIDENCE REPORT ====="
    Out $report
    Write-Host "`nEvidence saved to: $report"
    Write-Host "Do not paste secret keys or .env.local contents into chat."
}
