import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
    const anonKey =
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ||
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
    const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
    const paystackKey = process.env.PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY;

    if (!url || !anonKey || !serviceKey) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Supabase server configuration is incomplete." },
        { status: 503 },
      );
    }
    if (!paystackKey) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Paystack is not configured." },
        { status: 503 },
      );
    }

    const authorization = req.headers.get("authorization") || "";
    const match = authorization.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i);
    if (!match) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Sign in is required." }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const authClient = createClient(url, anonKey, {
      auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    });
    const { data: authData, error: authError } =
      await authClient.auth.getUser(match[1]);

    if (authError || !authData.user || !authData.user.email) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Your session is invalid. Sign in again." }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const rawAmount = String(body?.amount ?? "").trim();

    if (!/^\d{1,7}(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(rawAmount)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Enter a valid amount in GHS." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const amount = Number(rawAmount);
    const pesewas = Math.round(amount * 100);

    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pesewas) || pesewas < 100 || pesewas > 100000000) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Amount must be between GHS 1.00 and GHS 1,000,000.00." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const admin = createClient(url, serviceKey, {
      auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    });

    const reference = `SB-${randomUUID()}`;
    const { error: insertError } = await admin
      .from("paystack_transactions")
      .insert({
        user_id: authData.user.id,
        email: authData.user.email,
        reference,
        amount: (pesewas / 100).toFixed(2),
        currency: "GHS",
        status: "initialized",
        metadata: { platform: "skillbridge" },
      });

    if (insertError) {
      console.error("Unable to create payment record:", insertError.message);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Could not create the payment record." }, { status: 500 });
    }

    const siteUrl = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_URL || req.nextUrl.origin).replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const gatewayResponse = await fetch("https://api.paystack.co/transaction/initialize", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${paystackKey}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: authData.user.email,
        amount: pesewas,
        currency: "GHS",
        reference,
        callback_url: `${siteUrl}/dashboard?payment=return&reference=${encodeURIComponent(reference)}`,
        metadata: { user_id: authData.user.id, platform: "skillbridge" },
      }),
      cache: "no-store",
    });

    const gateway = await gatewayResponse.json();

    if (!gatewayResponse.ok || !gateway.status || !gateway.data?.authorization_url) {
      await admin.from("paystack_transactions")
        .update({ status: "failed", updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq("reference", reference)
        .eq("status", "initialized");

      console.error("Paystack initialization failed:", gateway.message || gateway.status);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Paystack could not initialize this payment." }, { status: 502 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      authorization_url: gateway.data.authorization_url,
      reference,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Payment initialization error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to start payment." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

===== FILE: apps\web\app\api\paystack-webhook\route.ts =====
Lines: 142
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const secret = process.env.PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY;
  const signature = request.headers.get("x-paystack-signature");

  if (!secret) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Payment service is not configured." }, { status: 503 });
  }
  if (!signature || !/^[a-f0-9]{128}$/i.test(signature)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid Paystack signature." }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const rawBody = await request.text();
  const expected = createHmac("sha512", secret).update(rawBody).digest();
  const supplied = Buffer.from(signature, "hex");

  if (supplied.length !== expected.length || !timingSafeEqual(supplied, expected)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid Paystack signature." }, { status: 401 });
  }

  let event: { event?: string; data?: { reference?: string } };
  try {
    event = JSON.parse(rawBody);
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid webhook payload." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (event.event !== "charge.success") {
    return NextResponse.json({ received: true, ignored: true });
  }

  const reference = event.data?.reference;
  if (!reference) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Payment reference is missing." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  if (!url || !serviceKey) {
    console.error("Missing server-side Supabase configuration for webhook.");
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Payment processing is not configured." }, { status: 503 });
  }

  const admin = createClient(url, serviceKey, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
  });

  try {
    const { data: payment, error: lookupError } = await admin
      .from("paystack_transactions")
      .select("user_id,reference,amount,currency,status")
      .eq("reference", reference)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (lookupError) throw lookupError;
    if (!payment || !payment.user_id) {
      console.error("Unknown Paystack reference:", reference);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Payment reference not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (payment.status === "success") {
      return NextResponse.json({ received: true, processed: true, already_processed: true });
    }

    if (payment.status !== "initialized") {
      return NextResponse.json({ received: true, ignored: true });
    }

    const verifyResponse = await fetch(
      `https://api.paystack.co/transaction/verify/${encodeURIComponent(reference)}`,
      {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${secret}` },
        cache: "no-store",
      },
    );

    const verification = await verifyResponse.json();
    const verified = verification?.data;

    if (!verifyResponse.ok || !verification?.status || !verified) {
      console.error("Paystack verification request failed for reference:", reference);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Could not verify payment." }, { status: 502 });
    }

    const expectedPesewas = Math.round(Number(payment.amount) * 100);
    if (
      verified.status !== "success" ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(verified.id) ||
      verified.id <= 0 ||
      verified.reference !== reference ||
      verified.currency !== "GHS" ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(expectedPesewas) ||
      verified.amount !== expectedPesewas
    ) {
      console.error("Paystack verification mismatch for reference:", reference);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Payment verification did not match the saved transaction." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const { data: creditResult, error: creditError } = await admin.rpc(
      "credit_paystack_wallet",
      {
        p_reference: reference,
        p_paystack_transaction_id: verified.id,
        p_amount: Number(payment.amount),
        p_currency: verified.currency,
        p_user_id: payment.user_id,
      },
    );

    if (creditError) {
      console.error("Wallet credit RPC failed:", creditError.message);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Wallet credit failed; Paystack may retry this webhook." }, { status: 500 });
    }

    const creditPayload = Array.isArray(creditResult)
      ? creditResult[0]
      : creditResult;

    if (
      !creditPayload ||
      typeof creditPayload !== "object" ||
      creditPayload.success !== true
    ) {
      console.error("Paystack wallet credit RPC did not explicitly confirm success.");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Wallet credit was not confirmed. Paystack may retry this webhook." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ received: true, processed: true, result: creditResult });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Paystack webhook processing error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Payment processing failed; retry is possible." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

===== FILE: apps\web\app\api\wallet\balance\route.ts =====
Lines: 87
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
    const anonKey =
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ||
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;

    if (!supabaseUrl || !anonKey) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Wallet service is not configured." },
        { status: 503 },
      );
    }

    const authorization = request.headers.get("authorization");
    const token = authorization?.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i)?.[1];

    if (!token) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Please sign in to view your wallet." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
      auth: {
        persistSession: false,
        autoRefreshToken: false,
      },
      global: {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
      },
    });

    const { data: authData, error: authError } =
      await supabase.auth.getUser(token);

    if (authError || !authData.user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Your session is invalid or expired." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    const { data: wallet, error: walletError } = await supabase
      .from("platform_wallets")
      .select("available_balance, total_earnings")
      .eq("user_id", authData.user.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (walletError) {
      console.error("Wallet balance lookup failed:", walletError.message);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Wallet balance is temporarily unavailable." },
        { status: 503 },
      );
    }

    const balance = wallet ? Number(wallet.available_balance) : 0;

    if (!Number.isFinite(balance) || balance < 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Wallet balance is invalid." },
        { status: 500 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      balance,
      currency: "GHS",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Wallet balance API failed:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Wallet balance is temporarily unavailable." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

PS>& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
    Set-Location "$HOME\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix"

    $reportDir = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path "release-reports"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null
    $report = Join-Path $reportDir ("skillbridge-final-diagnostics-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + ".txt")

    function Out([string]$s) {
        Write-Host $s
        Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $s
    }

    Out "===== 1. LIVE ROUTE STATUS ====="
    $curl = Get-Command curl.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($curl) {
        foreach ($path in @("/", "/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
            $code = & curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 25 "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app$path" 2>&1
            Out "$path => $code"
        }
    } else {
        Out "curl.exe unavailable; live HTTP status not checked."
    }

    Out "`n===== 2. TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION ====="
    Push-Location "apps\web"
    try {
        npm exec -- tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Out ([string]$_) }
        Out "TypeScript exit code: $LASTEXITCODE"
    } catch {
        Out "TypeScript check error: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }

    Out "`n===== 3. SUPABASE CLI AND CONFIG SEARCH ====="
    $cli = Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cli) {
        Out "Supabase CLI: $($cli.Source)"
        supabase --version 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Out ([string]$_) }
    } else {
        Out "Supabase CLI is not installed or not on PATH."
    }

    $configs = Get-ChildItem -Path (Get-Location).Path -Filter "config.toml" -File -Recurse `
        -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(node_modules|\.git|\.next)\\' }

    foreach ($cfg in $configs) {
        Out "Config found: $($cfg.FullName)"
    }
    if (-not $configs) {
        Out "No config.toml found outside dependency/build folders."
    }

    Out "`n===== 4. MIGRATION FILE CONTENT ====="
    $migration = "supabase\migrations\20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql"
    if (Test-Path $migration) {
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $migration | ForEach-Object { Out ([string]$_) }
    } else {
        Out "Expected migration file missing."
    }

    Out "`n===== 5. PAYMENT AND SUBMISSION IMPLEMENTATION MARKERS ====="
    $sourceFiles = @(
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-init\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\paystack-webhook\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\webhooks\paystack\route.ts",
        "apps\web\app\api\webhooks\dodo\route.ts",
        "apps\web\components\TaskWorkspace.tsx",
        "apps\web\app\api\wallet\balance\route.ts"
    )

    $patterns = @(
        "process\.env\.[A-Z0-9_]+",
        "create table",
        "create or replace function",
        "create policy",
        "grant execute",
        "credit_paystack_wallet",
        "paystack_transactions",
        "x-paystack-signature",
        "createHmac",
        "charge\.success",
        "authorization_url",
        "task_submissions",
        "submissionText",
        "submission_text",
        "\.from\(",
        "\.rpc\(",
        "dodopayments\.com"
    )

    foreach ($file in $sourceFiles) {
        Out "`n--- $file ---"
        if (Test-Path $file) {
            Select-String -LiteralPath $file -Pattern $patterns |
                ForEach-Object {
                    Out ("L{0}: {1}" -f $_.LineNumber, $_.Line.Trim())
                }
        } else {
            Out "FILE MISSING"
        }
    }

    Out "`n===== 6. MIGRATION FILE INVENTORY ====="
    if (Test-Path "supabase\migrations") {
        Get-ChildItem "supabase\migrations" -File |
            Sort-Object Name |
            ForEach-Object { Out $_.Name }
    } else {
        Out "supabase\migrations folder missing."
    }

    Out "`n===== DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE ====="
    Out "Report: $report"
    Write-Host "`nSaved report: $report"
    Write-Host "Share the report or paste its output. Do not share .env files or secret values."

-- SkillBridge Paystack credits and task submission compatibility.
-- Expected wallet schema: platform_wallets(user_id, available_balance, total_earnings).

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.user_id is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'platform_wallets'
      AND column_name = 'available_balance'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected public.platform_wallets.available_balance is missing. Resolve the deployed wallet schema before applying this migration.';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.task_submissions') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.task_submissions is missing.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_transactions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  email text NOT NULL,
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GHS' CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initialized',
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency text DEFAULT 'GHS',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS paystack_transactions_reference_uidx
  ON public.paystack_transactions(reference);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.paystack_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  paystack_transaction_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency text NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'GHS'),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;

ALTER TABLE public.task_submissions
  ALTER COLUMN file_storage_path DROP NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public)
VALUES ('task-deliverables', 'task-deliverables', false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner insert" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner insert"
ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner read" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner read"
ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "SkillBridge task files owner delete" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "SkillBridge task files owner delete"
ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
  bucket_id = 'task-deliverables'
  AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(
  p_reference text,
  p_paystack_transaction_id bigint,
  p_amount numeric,
  p_currency text,
  p_user_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  payment_row public.paystack_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR p_reference = ''
     OR p_paystack_transaction_id IS NULL OR p_paystack_transaction_id <= 0
     OR p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0
     OR p_currency <> 'GHS' OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid payment parameters.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO payment_row
  FROM public.paystack_transactions
  WHERE reference = p_reference
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment reference not found.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.user_id <> p_user_id
     OR payment_row.currency <> p_currency
     OR payment_row.amount <> p_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment details do not match.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status = 'success' THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
      WHERE reference = p_reference
        AND user_id = p_user_id
        AND amount = p_amount
        AND paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', true);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment marked successful without matching ledger entry.');
  END IF;

  IF payment_row.status <> 'initialized' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Payment is not awaiting credit.');
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    WHERE reference = p_reference
  ) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Ledger reference already exists.');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.paystack_wallet_ledger
    (reference, paystack_transaction_id, user_id, amount, currency)
  VALUES
    (p_reference, p_paystack_transaction_id, p_user_id, p_amount, p_currency);

  INSERT INTO public.platform_wallets
    (user_id, available_balance, total_earnings, updated_at)
  VALUES
    (p_user_id, p_amount, p_amount, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET available_balance = public.platform_wallets.available_balance + EXCLUDED.available_balance,
      total_earnings = public.platform_wallets.total_earnings + EXCLUDED.total_earnings,
      updated_at = now();

  UPDATE public.paystack_transactions
  SET status = 'success',
      paystack_transaction_id = p_paystack_transaction_id,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE reference = p_reference;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'already_processed', false);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.credit_paystack_wallet(text, bigint, numeric, text, uuid) TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.paystack_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.paystack_wallet_ledger ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger FROM anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.paystack_transactions TO service_role;
GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $migration)) {

    }

    $original = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($migration)
    $updated = $original.Replace(
        "ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_texttext;",
        "ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;"
    ).Replace(
        "GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledgerTO service_role;",
        "GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;"
    )

    if ($updated -ne $original) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $migration -Destination "$migration.before-typo-fix" -ErrorAction Stop
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
            $migration,
            $updated,
            [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
        )
        Write-Host "Corrected confirmed SQL typos; original backed up." -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host "The two exact typos were not found; migration left unchanged." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }

    $sql = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($migration)
    if ($sql -match "submission_texttext|paystack_wallet_ledgerTO") {
        throw "A known SQL typo remains. Stop before deployment."

        "total_earnings",
        "updated_at",
        "task_submissions",
        "file_storage_path",
        "credit_paystack_wallet"
    )) {
        if ($sql.Contains($marker)) {
            Write-Host "Found migration reference: $marker"
        } else {
            Write-Host "Migration does not reference: $marker" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== TYPESCRIPT CHECK =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location "apps\web"
    try {
        & npm exec -- tsc --noEmit

        }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== PRODUCTION BUILD =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Production build failed. Do not deploy."

    Write-Host "`n===== RESULT =====" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "Build passed. No database migration was applied."
    Write-Host "Do not treat wallet top-ups as production-ready until the live database schema and migration status are verified."

PS>& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
    Set-Location "$HOME\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix"

    $root = (Get-Location).Path
    $reportDir = Join-Path $root "release-reports"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null
    $report = Join-Path $reportDir ("skillbridge-completion-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss") + ".txt")
    Start-Transcript -Path $report -Force | Out-Null

    try {
        Write-Host "`n===== 1. VERIFY EXISTING PROJECT =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        if (-not (Test-Path "package.json")) {
            throw "Root package.json is missing. Stopping without creating a new project."
        }
        if (-not (Test-Path "apps\web\package.json")) {
            throw "apps\web\package.json is missing."
        }
        if (-not (Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            throw "npm is unavailable in this terminal."
        }

        git status --short
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "Git status unavailable; continuing with the existing working directory." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        Write-Host "`n===== 2. FIX ONLY THE TWO KNOWN SQL TYPOS =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        $migration = Join-Path $root "supabase\migrations\20261015050000_skillbridge_paystack_task_hardening.sql"

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $migration) {
            $original = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($migration)
            $updated = $original.Replace(
                "ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_texttext;",
                "ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_text text;"
            ).Replace(
                "GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledgerTO service_role;",
                "GRANT ALL ON public.paystack_wallet_ledger TO service_role;"
            )

            if ($updated -ne $original) {
                Copy-Item -LiteralPath $migration -Destination "$migration.before-completion-fix" -ErrorAction Stop
                [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
                    $migration,
                    $updated,
                    [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
                )
                Write-Host "Known SQL typos corrected; original backed up." -ForegroundColor Green
            } else {
                Write-Host "No matching SQL typos remain."
            }

            $sql = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($migration)
            if ($sql -match "submission_texttext|paystack_wallet_ledgerTO") {
                throw "SQL typo verification failed."
            }
        } else {
            Write-Host "Migration file not found; no database changes will be attempted." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        Write-Host "`n===== 3. CHECK VERCEL LINK AND LOGIN =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        if (-not (Test-Path ".vercel\project.json")) {
            throw "This folder has no .vercel\project.json link. Stopping to avoid deploying to the wrong project."
        }
        if (-not (Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            throw "Vercel CLI is not installed or not on PATH. No deployment attempted."
        }

        & vercel whoami
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Vercel login check failed. Sign in with vercel login, then rerun this block."
        }

        Write-Host "`n===== 4. TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Push-Location "apps\web"
        try {
            & npm exec -- tsc --noEmit
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                throw "TypeScript validation failed. Deployment stopped."
            }
        } finally {
            Pop-Location
        }

        Write-Host "`n===== 5. PRODUCTION BUILD =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & npm run build
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Production build failed. Deployment stopped."
        }

        Write-Host "`n===== 6. DEPLOY EXISTING LINKED PROJECT =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & vercel --prod --yes
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Vercel production deployment failed. Review the Vercel error above."
        }

        Write-Host "`n===== 7. VERIFY PRODUCTION PAGES =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
        foreach ($path in @("/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
            $status = & curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 30 "$base$path"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                Write-Host "$path => request failed" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            } else {
                Write-Host "$path => HTTP $status"
            }
        }

        Write-Host "`n===== 8. PAYMENT AND DATABASE LIMITATION =====" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host "The app build and deployment do not prove that the Supabase migration is applied."
        Write-Host "No payment was initiated and no SQL was executed against production."
        Write-Host "Verify the live Supabase schema and migration status before enabling real wallet credits."
        Write-Host "Do not share .env files or secret values."

        Write-Host "`nCOMPLETION RUN FINISHED. Review all deployment and HTTP results above." -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    catch {
        Write-Host "`nSTOPPED: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "Resolve the reported issue before retrying. Existing project files were not replaced wholesale."
    }
    finally {
        Stop-Transcript | Out-Null
        Write-Host "`nDiagnostic log: $report"
    }
}

PS>& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
    Set-Location "$HOME\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix"

    if (-not (Test-Path ".vercel\project.json")) {
        throw "No linked Vercel project found. Stopping to avoid deploying to the wrong project."
    }
    if (-not (Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        throw "Vercel CLI is unavailable."
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== LINKED VERCEL PROJECT =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Get-Content ".vercel\project.json" |
        ConvertFrom-Json |
        Select-Object projectId, orgId |
        Format-List

    & vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Vercel login is required. Run vercel login, then rerun this block."
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== EXISTING PRODUCTION VARIABLE NAMES =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $envListing = (& vercel env ls production 2>&1 | Out-String)
    Write-Host ($envListing -replace '(?im)(=|\s)\S*(?:secret|token|key)\S*', '$1[REDACTED]')
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not read production environment-variable listing."
    }

    $required = @(
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL",
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY",
        "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY",
        "PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY",
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL"
    )

    foreach ($name in $required) {
        if ($envListing -match "(?im)^\s*$([regex]::Escape($name))\s") {
            Write-Host "$name already appears in the production listing; leaving it unchanged." -ForegroundColor Green
            continue
        }

        Write-Host "`nMissing production variable: $name" -ForegroundColor Yellow

        switch ($name) {
            "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL" {
                Write-Host "Enter your Supabase project URL, e.g. https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co"
            }
            "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" {
                Write-Host "Enter the Supabase anon/public key. Do not use the service-role key here."
            }
            "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" {
                Write-Host "Enter the Supabase service-role secret. Keep it server-side and private."
            }
            "PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY" {
                Write-Host "Enter your Paystack secret key for the correct live/test environment."
            }
            "NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL" {
                Write-Host "Enter https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
            }
        }

        & vercel env add $name production
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Could not add $name. Check the CLI prompt/error before continuing."
        }
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== VERIFY ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE NAMES =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & vercel env ls production
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not verify production environment variables."
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location "apps\web"
    try {
        & npm exec -- tsc --noEmit
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "TypeScript validation failed; deployment stopped."
        }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== PRODUCTION BUILD =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Build failed; deployment stopped."
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== DEPLOY EXISTING LINKED PROJECT =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & vercel --prod --yes
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Production deployment failed."
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== CHECK PRODUCTION PAGES =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    foreach ($path in @("/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
        $status = & curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 30 "$base$path"
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            Write-Host "$path => HTTP $status"
        } else {
            Write-Host "$path => request failed; check Vercel deployment protection." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }

    Write-Host "`nDeployment run finished. This does not apply or verify the Supabase migration." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

]633;D]633;A]633;P;Cwd=C:\x5cUsers\x5cICESSES\x5cDownloads\x5cSKILLBRIDGE-live-fixPS C:\Users\ICESSES\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix> ]633;B
PS>& {
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
    Set-Location "$HOME\Downloads\SKILLBRIDGE-live-fix"

    $web = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path "apps\web"
    $envFile = Join-Path $web ".env.local"
    $vercel = Join-Path $env:APPDATA "npm\vercel.cmd"

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $web "package.json"))) {
        throw "Existing apps\web project not found. No files changed."
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path ".vercel\project.json")) {
        throw "Existing Vercel project link missing. No deployment attempted."
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path $vercel)) {
        $cmd = Get-Command vercel.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($cmd) { $vercel = $cmd.Source }
        else { throw "vercel.cmd not found. Repair the existing Vercel CLI first." }
    }

    function Read-EnvValue([string]$Name, [string[]]$Lines) {
        $escaped = [regex]::Escape($Name)
        for ($i = $Lines.Count - 1; $i -ge 0; $i--) {
            if ($Lines[$i] -match "^\s*$escaped\s*=\s*(.*)$") {
                $v = $Matches[1].Trim()
                if (($v.StartsWith('"') -and $v.EndsWith('"')) -or
                    ($v.StartsWith("'") -and $v.EndsWith("'"))) {
                    $v = $v.Substring(1, $v.Length - 2)
                }
                return $v
            }
        }
        return ""
    }

    function Set-EnvLine([string]$Name, [string]$Value, [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]$Lines) {
        $escaped = [regex]::Escape($Name)
        $found = $false
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Lines.Count; $i++) {
            if ($Lines[$i] -match "^\s*$escaped\s*=") {
                $Lines[$i] = "$Name=$Value"
                $found = $true
            }
        }
        if (-not $found) { $Lines.Add("$Name=$Value") }
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== 1. READ LOCAL CONFIG WITHOUT PRINTING SECRETS =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $lines = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    if (Test-Path $envFile) {
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $envFile | ForEach-Object { $lines.Add([string]$_) }
    }

    $url = if ($env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL) {
        $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.Trim()
    } else {
        Read-EnvValue "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL" $lines.ToArray()
    }

    $key = if ($env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) {
        $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.Trim()
    } elseif ($env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) {
        $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.Trim()
    } else {
        $saved = Read-EnvValue "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" $lines.ToArray()
        if (-not $saved) { $saved = Read-EnvValue "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" $lines.ToArray() }
        $saved
    }

    $parsedUrl = $null
    $validUrl = [System.Uri]::TryCreate($url, [System.UriKind]::Absolute, [ref]$parsedUrl) -and
                $parsedUrl.Scheme -in @("https", "http") -and
                -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parsedUrl.Host) -and
                $parsedUrl.Host -notmatch "^(example|your-project|placeholder)(\.|$)"

    if (-not $validUrl) {
        Write-Host "Local Supabase URL is missing or invalid." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        $url = (Read-Host "Enter the real Supabase Project URL from Supabase Settings > API").Trim()
        $parsedUrl = $null
        $validUrl = [System.Uri]::TryCreate($url, [System.UriKind]::Absolute, [ref]$parsedUrl) -and
                    $parsedUrl.Scheme -in @("https", "http") -and
                    -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parsedUrl.Host) -and
                    $parsedUrl.Host -notmatch "^(example|your-project|placeholder)(\.|$)"
        if (-not $validUrl) {
            throw "That URL is not a valid HTTP/HTTPS project URL. Copy the actual Project URL from Supabase and rerun."
        }
    } else {
        Write-Host "Existing Supabase URL is syntactically valid."
    }

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($key) -or $key -match "YOUR_|PLACEHOLDER|EXAMPLE") {
        Write-Host "A usable public Supabase key was not found." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        $key = (Read-Host "Enter the matching Supabase anon/public or publishable key").Trim()
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($key)) {
            throw "Public Supabase key is required. No build or deployment attempted."
        }
    }

    if ($url -match "[`r`n]" -or $key -match "[`r`n]") {
        throw "Invalid multiline environment value. No build or deployment attempted."
    }

    Write-Host "Supabase URL host validated: $($parsedUrl.Host)"
    Write-Host "Public key is present; its value will not be printed."

    if (Test-Path $envFile) {
        $backup = "$envFile.before-supabase-fix-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss').bak"
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $envFile -Destination $backup
        Write-Host "Environment backup created: $backup"
    }

    Set-EnvLine "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL" $url $lines
    if ($env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY -or
        (Read-EnvValue "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" $lines.ToArray())) {
        Set-EnvLine "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" $key $lines
    } else {
        Set-EnvLine "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" $key $lines
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines(
        $envFile,
        $lines.ToArray(),
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL = $url
    if ($env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY -or
        (Read-EnvValue "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" $lines.ToArray())) {
        $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY = $key
    } else {
        $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = $key
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== 2. CHECK EXISTING VERCEL LOGIN =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & $vercel whoami
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel login failed. No deployment attempted." }

    Write-Host "`n===== 3. TYPESCRIPT VALIDATION =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $web
    try {
        & npm.cmd exec -- tsc --noEmit
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "TypeScript check failed. Deployment stopped." }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== 4. PRODUCTION BUILD =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & npm.cmd run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Build still fails. Do not deploy; inspect the first error above."
    }

    Write-Host "`n===== 5. DEPLOY EXISTING VERCEL PROJECT =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & $vercel --prod --yes
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Vercel deployment failed." }

    Write-Host "`n===== 6. CHECK LIVE ROUTES =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $base = "https://skillbridge-web-snowy.vercel.app"
    foreach ($path in @("/auth", "/dashboard", "/tasks", "/team")) {
        $status = & curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 30 "$base$path"
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            Write-Host "$path => HTTP $status"
        } else {
            Write-Host "$path => request failed; check Vercel protection." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }

    Write-Host "`nBUILD AND DEPLOY STEPS FINISHED." -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "This does not apply the Supabase migration or verify Paystack wallet credits."
    Write-Host "Keep service-role and Paystack secret keys server-side. Never paste them into chat."
}
